The best real route is his own Gleneagles profile page plus the LB Nagar branch appointment line 63665 62041, which was re-checked with an exact-phrase search and came back attached to the official https://www.gleneagleshospitals.co.in/hyderabad/lb-nagar branch page. It is a BRANCH appointment line, not his personal number, so it is recorded in hospital_number and not in professional_phone. JustDial listings surfaced for him and were ignored as call-tracking proxies. BANDING: only one official source (the Gleneagles group's own domain, counted once across both its URL families); Practo and DocIndia are corroborating only - hence Medium.
